title: Is multi accounts at the same time meta in this game?

posts.cooked: Yes, it is. The average number of accounts per player was about 3 during the COVID shutdowns (last official figure I know). Not sure what it is today, but probably a little higher. There are still players with single accounts today, but they're mostly from the new player demographic, and a minority.

Yeah, it's the longer you play, the more you'll feel as though an alt would be helpful.You can win in the game without boxing, you just have to make use of the other players in the game and group up with them.If you want to go hard into industry, or you plan on doing anything with capital ships, then you're probably going to want a second character, trained up to Recons (for cynos) which is probably several months of omega training. Because training is happening in real time, the sooner you decide to make your alt, the better it ends up being. As it won't be that far behind your main on SP. Some people just use the opportunity to train two characters in different ways. So for example one character might be gallente / minmatar or amarr / caldari.Maybe you want one character to focus on shield tanked ships, and another character focus on armour tanked ships. There are 100s of ways to do this depending on what it is you want to do long term. I wanted a hauling character at first, today both my characters are sort of one part of the whole, one does Amarr / Caldari / Precursor (very little gallente) ships up to battleships / marauders + dreads, the other is Gallente / Minmatar (& some caldari - very little Amarr)so depending on the ship types usually depends on which character i'm bringing.
Unless you plan to get intoMining/IndustryCapital shipsNo not really everything else ive found you dont really need an alt for

Scouting is handy to have if you live in w-space for sure, if you get rolled out you can have an alt scan a new way out rather than trying to scan your way back in which could take forever, just having a frig go ahead and check what is on the other side of gates and wormholes. rather than leeroying every ship with zero fks given.Same for webbing freighters (although this requires your corp to have friendly fire enabled, if it's not enabled your Rapier will get concorded) because you warp at 3/4 of your max speed, if you web or double web a freighter its max speed will prob be like 10ms or something, which only takes a second to reach so it'll warp instantly.

High sec is safer for newer players, but plenty of people just stage out of where ever, join any group so long as you have more than just you, you have a better chance of taking on groups of a similar size, or you can run better ISK making content. I use jump clones to switch into different areas or roles.Basically, you want to run with enough people so that you can take on other small groups and hold the field.Remember that boxing more characters just means you have more to lose if you do take them both into somewhere they can be killed without concord joining in. risking one ship at a time is much more cost effective.

You work around it, I've never had an issue with boxers preventing me from doing anything.To me, it is no different to there being the same number of players.if one guy is boxing 2 accounts, it's the same as there being two players. can you run into two players in Eve, yes you can, you can run into full 256 man fleets of players. can you realistically box a 256 man fleet? no you can't. so there is a number of players you can gather, that will decimate any similar number of accounts being boxed by 1 person?In other words, the power that can't be over come is that which is gained from having more OTHER PLAYERS, not more accounts. Because more players is better than having more accounts. the point of contention isn't that you can box 30 accounts, the problem is that no matter how many accounts you box, there will still be a larger more formidable group of individual players roaming around somewhere that you can quite easily also run into and be sht on by.You have to rely on the other players in the game to do the end game things, I recently bought a Dread, but I can't just use it whenever I want without losing it. It's only 'safe' when there is a fleet of subcaps around to stop it from getting tackled. All the end game ships are like this, not that great by themselves, very susceptible to death by 1000 papercuts.The big power struggles between groups of 1000s isn't won and lost by boxing more and more accounts, its by having more actual players over different timezones. It's all fine and dandy having one guy in your EU TZ that can box 30 accounts, but he's not winning wars by himself.

Yes, assuming people aren't input broadcasting, there should be a delay between each account targeting and shooting a target.While you can use hotkeys to flick through accounts, you still need to f1, click target in overview, tab to next, f1, pick target in overview, tab, pick target in overview.The more times you have to do this, the bigger the delay should be between the first account and the XXth account. Meanwhile, accounts being played by individual players don't have this reaction delay.10 players vs 1 guy boxing 10 accounts should be no contest, the 10 players should be able to target and kill his boxed toons faster than he can target and kill one of the 10 players. This is how it's balanced. (or meant to be, if people are input broadcasting then that is something else and is not inline with what you're meant to be doing ie. it's against the ToS - I've never used input broadcasting, even when it was allowed, I just never needed to with 2 characters, I tab or use Eve-O Preview to switch between accounts, but every action is unique to that account. even running just two accounts, doing PvE I always prefer to run 1 gunboat and 1 drone boat, because drones are fire and forget (set guard or assist to the gunboat never need to do anything else), while constantly tabbing back and forth to lock targets and shoot is annoying)It gets worst in fleets where an FC is saying things like 'align planet 5 moon 11' and now you have to do that on your 10 accounts, and the ones that don't do this within the next 10 seconds get tackled and die, good luck.assuming people aren't cheating by broadcasting commands / mouse action across multiple account, boxing is balanced by the diminishing returns of spreading a single attention span, thinner and thinner and thinner until you can no longer react to anything that is happening in a meaningful way.
